title: Include nested extra_serializer in GeneralFieldsSerializer GC traversal
answers: Why does Python GC fail to collect cyclic references involving model serializers with extra fields?
How to ensure nested serializers in GeneralFieldsSerializer are visited by the Python garbage collector?
Which fields must be passed to impl_py_gc_traverse for pydantic-core serializers?
body:
Symptom: Memory leak when objects with cyclic references are serialized with extra fields, as Python garbage collection fails to reclaim them.
Root cause: pydantic-core/src/serializers/fields.rs:GeneralFieldsSerializer omitted `extra_serializer` from `impl_py_gc_traverse!`.
Fix pattern: Include all child fields holding Python references or nested serializers in the `impl_py_gc_traverse!` macro invocation.
Constraints: Applies to PyO3 serializer types with child fields holding Python references or nested serializers; does not apply to non-Python primitive fields such as usize.
applies: Python GC traversal in pydantic-core serializer implementations.
